note: Mercer County, MO (29129). The ArcGIS REST host maps.mercercounty.org is Mercer County, New Jersey (East Windsor Twp parcels), not Missouri; its Mercer folder requires a token. Third-party directories name the Mercer County Assessor in Princeton, MO but link no public county parcel viewer or service. Missouri parcel data found only via commercial vendors (landrecords.us, Equator Studios, acres.com, acrevalue). MSDIS open data has no Mercer County parcel layer. No public queryable parcel service or file was found.
